semantic.justification: Task202610231627-0F8SYR: Writer import API attachment uses canonical document/nodes/registered positions/items rather than a separate document representation. Paragraph/page/numbering style families, descriptors, canonical owner attachment, inheritance and typed properties. Only the current canonical Writer core slice is represented. Full UNO service metadata/query interfaces, listeners, interactive undo/actions, Unicode cursor navigation, layout, unsupported character/table/conditional styles, ranges in unsupported sections, expanded bookmarks and wider properties remain unverified or unported. DomainMapper, OOXML package parser and export are outside this task; no whole-module parity claim. Task 202610231745-0YVMQG routes the represented ODT text, paragraph properties, common styles, numbering, bookmarks and cell text through shared XMLTextImportHelper and real Writer text/cursor/style/service owners. Removes SwXMLParagraphTarget and direct ordinary filter item construction. Native table structure and end-document node adjustment retain Writer-specific core responsibility. Character automatic styles use document-pooled handles and CharAutoStyleName; common versus automatic numbering retain separate ownership and export streams. Font scalar members, paragraph controls, page, line-number and consumed property contracts are exercised by focused API/ODT tests. Soft page break XML is ignored as in pinned XMLParaContext. Opaque automatic rule and style names are document-local identities. Full engine/UNO services, unrepresented style families/properties, layout and DOCX remain outside this slice; prior semantic statuses and registered I/O deviations are unchanged. Task SWRD7X verifies native descriptor/property-state and bookmark lifetime scenarios. SwXBookmark delegates duplicate-name allocation to MarkManager and checks same-name/colliding renames before the core mutation, preserving the native RuntimeException boundary. Style parent/follow and family names use the existing paragraph pool and SwStyleNameMapper programmatic names, including Standard versus Default Paragraph Style, rather than treating programmatic names as raw UI strings. The mapper adds only English paragraph pool-ID lookups; localized/all-family mapping and custom user-suffix disambiguation remain unported. No broad semantic status promotion. Task SWRD7X retains native owner and dispatch invariants: attached bookmark marks always retain their document/text owners; property metadata validates represented style keys before dispatch; a bounded cursor decrement stays inside the current node array; native generated numbering compounds share one addressed-copy path; an active import cell exists whenever its saved body cursor is present. Remove only redundant impossible alternatives, retaining public invalid-owner and unsupported-property failures. No coverage exclusions, thresholds, semantic statuses or broader parity claims change. Task V4DQJW page-frame prerequisite replaces the geometry-only SwPageDesc state with four document-pool-owned SwFrameFormat owners, native usage flags, registered-name uniqueness and copy/follow behavior. SwTextGridItem retains native eleven-field defaults, typed UNO members and paper-mode arithmetic; page UNO properties use actual pooled items. Browser graph records retain all four direct item sets, independent frame names and optional native user grid defaults; legacy geometry ingress remains explicit. Consumed ItemInfoStatic/User metadata now serves registered pool defaults without inventing contiguous ranges. Complete frame-size codec is shared with tables; LR browser transport copies original raw scalar fields including propLeft/propRight through explicit host field access, avoiding proportional setter rescaling. This host serialization binding is local infrastructure, not native semantic certification. SectionPropertyMap/default-page-mode/document/style loading, DOCX export/Open/download and ODT grid serialization remain pending. Existing statuses and intentional recovery/autosave/file UI deviations are preserved. V4DQJW section attachment prerequisite adds real SwXPageStyle identity, native typed page factory/family entrypoints, lazy DomainMapper page-family cache and original scan-once Converted suffix allocation using o3tl signed32 prefix conversion. Section contexts now own SectionPropertyMap with original consumed Letter dimensions, one-inch margins, typed ALL layout and disabled grid defaults. GetPageStyle retains cached actual wrappers and original UNO-only catch/name-reservation behavior. ApplyProperties_ retains ordinary-then-character-bag-then-paragraph-bag order, section-only protection exclusion, real UNO failure catch and partial-write semantics. Existing page property algorithms remain on the inherited SwXStyle implementation over actual SwPageDesc; no parallel catalog, property DTO or fabricated model is introduced. Actual Any get signed32 specialization ports default initialization, extraction and original cppu failure diagnostic. This is source-backed evidence, not compiled native differential. Complete section field owners, SetStart/pre-start cursor navigation, CloseSectionGroup/header/footer/columns, section parser mapping, document/style loading, DOCX export and production file workflows remain pending; all previous semantic statuses and intentional file UI/autosave/recovery deviations remain unchanged. S3HW1E native character-style application checkpoint: actual SwXStyle/SwXStyleFamily/SwXStyleFamilies and SwXTextDocument now admit CharacterStyles over genuine SwCharFormat and lazy document pool owners. Character property metadata excludes cursor/paragraph/frame items and preserves source MAYBEVOID/NONE flags. Character descriptor values retain native deferred validation and sorted application; attached character item vectors stage into an actual cloned item set and commit once, preserving explicit default item presence and rollback on invalid later values. Public multi-property unknown errors use actual WrappedTargetException/Any owners. Character names use original programmatic/UI aliases, default identity, collision lookup and source suffix length guard (WRITER207). RTF creation uses these real family/descriptor services, resets existing represented direct pool properties via original SetPropertiesToDefault, and keeps source raw references separate from a second owned deduplicateStyleTable result. The original source parent-name lookup and actual RTFSprms normalization precede model application. Admitted style properties pass through a real StyleSheetEntry/StyleSheetPropertyMap, actual mapper stylesheet context, stable native PropValVector and genuine Sequence<OUString>/Sequence<Any> into real UNO style setters. Existing erased sequence-address binding uses borrowed OUString views and actual by-value Any copies at the API boundary; physical layout and whole ABI are unverified. Remaining legacy strike/highlight/escapement and paragraph/table callbacks, complete native style pool/base-sheet orchestration, descriptor edge families, paragraph bulk staging, parser-wide native properties, script metadata, replay/substreams and earlier TXT/RTF/Markdown/HTML obligations remain open. Native desktop differential and whole-filter/module semantic closure are not claimed.
